provenance.evidence: ROM scene-3 record 99 at 0x18ABB4; event-table row 1 at 0x18A6FC selects scene 13. The mode-3/event-1 selector at 0x1F77C loads root 0xF4A18 and sets FFF10D=0x32; command EA at 0x249FA tests FF018F bit 2, selecting free text 0x114EF5 or the 50-nuyen offer 0x114E66. Command 0x06 charges the active amount and selects shared paid/insufficient feedback; 0x1F816 enters Hotel Options only when FFF10D is negative. The prompt returns D6=-1, so event-table scene 13 is retained as evidence and is not the normal arrival destination. Signed run results select package text roots 0xF49E0/0xF4A50.
